title: List page
summary: A filterable, sortable, paginated list of records: a pk-data-table (the one implementation of the query, load and states: a manual pk-table, a pk-table-filters search/filter panel and a pk-pagination footer) under an optional title bar, with optional toolbar actions. Set the load(query) callback as a property (business logic, never config data) - it receives { page, pageSize, sort, sortDir, search, filters } and returns (or resolves to) { rows, total, filterOptions? } for that page (filterOptions: { filterKey: [{ value, label }] } replaces those select filters' options, e.g. labels with counts); a rejection shows the built-in error state with Retry, and zero rows show the configured empty state. rowHref(row), also a callback property, makes rows clickable and is called instead of the element navigating itself, so the host wires its router.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Rows raise pk-row-click when clicked (or Enter/Space on the focused row). Without it only rowHref makes rows clickable.

props.name: rowHrefTemplate
props.description: Row links: an address with {id} (and any {field}, URL-encoded), like /orders/{id} or #/orders/{id}. The first cell of each row becomes a real link; a plain click on it or the row goes through the router (pk-navigate). Plain data, so a wrapper can set it (rowHref is a callback).

props.name: navigate
props.description: Who follows a row link: router (default, empty), host or none.

props.name: config
props.description: { columns, filters?, actions?, empty?, pageSize? }. columns is pk-table's own column definitions ({ key, label, type?, align?, sortable?, hidePhone?, shed?, title? }[]). filters is [{ key, type: 'text'|'email'|'number'|'date'|'select'|'multiselect', label, options? }] (a select's options are [{ value, label? }] or plain strings), rendered into the pk-table-filters panel and combined into query.filters as { [key]: text }. actions is [{ label, href?, variant? }], toolbar buttons shown beside the search box . empty is { heading?, description? } shown when a page has zero rows. selectable? (boolean) shows the checkbox column and the bulk bar, rowKey? names the row field that identifies a row (default id), bulkActions? is [{ id, label, variant? }], the buttons of the bulk bar. pageSize is the initial page size (default 25); search?, filterValues?, sort?, sortDir? and page? seed the first query. Title bar: heading?: string and breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }]; nothing is drawn when neither is set. toolbarInHeader? puts them in the toolbar row with the search (no pk-page-header: no sticky header or back link). cards? (default true unless selectable): cards below 640px. searchPlaceholder? is the search box text (placeholder and accessible name; searchLabel wins if both are set). selectPageOnly? (with selectable) selects only the loaded page and never offers "Select all N", so pk-bulk scope is always "page". stickyHeader? (boolean) pins the column header; in a flex column of definite height (a pk-stack[fill], an app-shell body) the rows scroll and the pager and bulk bar stay pinned.

slots.name: before-list
slots.description: Content between the title bar and the list (an alert, a summary card). It keeps its height while the page has room, else shrinks and scrolls in its own box, so the list keeps --pk-list-page-table-min and a tall summary never squeezes the rows to zero; with stickyHeader the column header and pager stay pinned. With no definite body height the page scrolls as a whole.

events.name: pk-select

detail.query: { page, pageSize, sort, sortDir, search, filters }

events.description: The selection changed (config.selectable), passed through from the pk-data-table. For scope 'all' run the bulk action against query on the server, never against the ids.

events.name: pk-row-click
events.description: A row was activated (clickable): id is the rowKey value, row the row object from load(). The data table's own event, passed through.

events.name: pk-bulk
events.description: A button of config.bulkActions was pressed: its id and the selection at that moment, as pk-select carries it.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-header with the breadcrumb and actions from config. Hidden when config sets none of them.

parts.name: table
parts.description: The pk-data-table, which owns the query, the load, the states, the search/filter panel and the pager (its own parts: table, filters, pagination, state; part('filters'), part('pagination') and part('state') on this page reach them).

parts.name: before
parts.description: The box around the before-list slot; shrinks and scrolls when the page is short, hidden while empty.

parts.name: footer
parts.description: The table footer bar (the pager sits in it): a top rule and block padding (--pk-table-footer-padding).

parts.name: pager
parts.description: The pk-pagination bar (its nav), exported from the pager.

parts.name: bulk
parts.description: Holds one button per config.bulkActions entry, in the data table's bulk bar (shown while rows are selected).

parts.name: actions
parts.description: Holds one button per config.actions entry, in the data table's actions slot at the end of the toolbar.

cssProperties.name: --pk-list-page-table-min
cssProperties.description: The least height the list keeps while a before-list region is slotted.

a11y: Every filter field is a labelled real control (pk-input/pk-select, showLabel on); the table, search box and pagination keep their own roles, names and announcements; the loading and error states use pk-skeleton and pk-alert's own roles and announcements.

examples.title: Orders list (config and load are set from script)
